01 / ABOUT

The person
behind the work.

I’m Erick Benitez-Ramos (Erick Benitez), a software engineer with experience at Casco and Amazon Web Services.

My interest in technology began in middle school, when my uncle taught me how to jailbreak an iPhone. I began programming in my junior year of high school—about nine years ago.

Beyond technology, I’m passionate about spirituality, health, and fitness. This is a home for my work, ideas, and the things that keep me curious beyond a screen.
